prompt:
Our sports analytics platform receives odds data from four different partner feeds, each using a completely different format. We need to reconcile all of them into a single unified reference document for our prediction market integration team.

The raw input files are already in `feeds/raw/` — read the `TASK.md` in the workspace root for the full details of what's there. Some feeds may contain malformed or out-of-range entries that need to be handled gracefully rather than just crashing.

Please produce a file called `odds_reconciliation_report.txt` in the workspace root. It should have four clearly labeled sections covering: (1) the batch of American odds converted to a full comparison table, (2) the European fractional odds each converted to all equivalent formats, (3) the analyst probability estimates converted to all formats (handle any suspicious-looking values appropriately), and (4) the Asian decimal odds converted to all formats (flag any entries that can't be valid).
